answer:
John Lynch-Staunton served as the **interim leader** of the **Conservative Party of Canada** (from December 8, 2003, until March 19, 2004). He also was the Leader of the Opposition in the Senate and the first Leader of the Senate caucus for the party.

As of 2026, the federal leader of the Conservative Party of Canada is **Pierre Poilievre**, who retained his position after winning a leadership review in January 2026.
